# rm

Remove files and directory trees through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/rm temporary.txt

moonx cli/rm --interactive=always unwanted.txt

moonx cli/rm -r old-output
```

Process operands without following symbolic links. Recursive removal protects filesystem roots by default; explicit confirmation reads stdin.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-r`, `--recursive` | Remove directory trees. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Ignore missing files and disable prompts. |
| `-d`, `--dir` | Remove empty directories. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Show removals. |
| `--interactive VALUE` | Select always, once or never; a bare flag selects always. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Terminal-sensitive write-protection prompts are unavailable. Use an explicit interactive mode when confirmation is needed.
- Final dot/dot-dot operands and symbolic-link operands ending in a separator are refused. Earlier successful removals are not rolled back.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
